observations.title: Change climbing speed by looking along the ladder
observations.player_action: Look upward while ascending or downward while descending.
observations.outcome: The viewing angle controls the increase in climbing speed, within the configured multiplier.
conditions: Server movement policy and other movement mods can affect whether a client-side speed change is accepted.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
